title: HR Recruiter
description: We are seeking a motivated and dynamic HR Recruiter to join our team in Kerala or Tamil Nadu. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in our talent acquisition efforts, helping us identify and attract top talent to meet our organizational needs. As an HR Recruiter, you will be responsible for managing the end-to-end recruitment process, from sourcing candidates to conducting interviews and facilitating the hiring process. Key responsibilities include collaborating with hiring managers to understand their staffing needs, developing job descriptions, posting job openings on various platforms, screening resumes, and conducting initial interviews. You will also be responsible for maintaining candidate databases and ensuring a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process. The successful candidate should possess strong communication skills, particularly in Malayalam, and have a keen eye for identifying talent. Familiarity with recruitment tools and platforms is a plus. If you are passionate about connecting people with opportunities and are looking to kickstart your career in HR, we encourage you to apply. Join us in shaping the future of our workforce!This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**Company Description**
Sephora Infosolutions Private Limited is a leading audio-visual solutions provider delivering advanced technology to the education and corporate sectors. The organization is managed by experienced professionals with a strong track record in building and scaling start-up businesses. Sephora Infosolutions partners with global technology leaders to design and implement customized audio and visual communication setups, including conference rooms, boardrooms, auditoriums, and stadiums. The company focuses on tailored solutions that meet the needs of diverse stakeholders and offers interactive flat panel displays (IFPD) from brands such as AORA and Specktron across multiple industries.
  
**Role Description**
The Human Resources Business Partner is a full-time, on-site role based in Kerala, India. This role is responsible for aligning HR initiatives with business objectives, advising leadership on people-related strategies, and supporting organizational growth. Day-to-day responsibilities include developing and implementing HR policies, managing employee relations, overseeing performance management processes, and ensuring compliance with labor and employment laws. The HR Business Partner will collaborate with managers to address workforce planning, support talent development, and foster a positive, inclusive work environment. The role also involves maintaining HR documentation, handling employee queries, and contributing to continuous improvement of HR practices.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong foundation in Human Resources (HR) and HR Policies, with the ability to design, implement, and communicate HR frameworks effectively.
* Experience in Employee Relations, including handling grievances, conflict resolution, and promoting an engaging and respectful workplace.
* Knowledge of Labor and Employment Law, with demonstrated ability to ensure compliance and manage risk in HR operations.
* Background in Performance Management, including goal setting, appraisal processes, feedback frameworks, and development planning.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; postgraduate qualification or HR certification is an advantage.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across levels.
* Proven experience in an HR Business Partner or similar HR generalist role, preferably in technology, AV solutions, or related industries.
* Ability to work on-site in Kerala, India, with a hands-on, collaborative approach and proficiency in HRIS tools and MS Office.

title: Resourcing Manager
description:
We are a specialist data consultancy helping organisations unlock the true value of their data. Our work spans AI readiness strategy, data literacy, real-time reporting, and data management through mergers and acquisitions.

We are looking for an experienced Resourcing Manager to join our growing team and take ownership of "casting" the right data professionals onto the right client projects.

**About the role**

You will act as the bridge between our bench of consultants and live client engagements — matching skills, experience and culture to project requirements and ensuring we can deploy quickly and confidently.

**Key responsibilities**

* Match data professionals to client projects based on technical fit, client culture and project objectives.
* Build and maintain accurate role profiles reflecting required skills and experience.
* Manage a bench of available consultants in collaboration with our consulting capabilities team.
* Coordinate consultant transitions between assignments with project managers.
* Manage relationships with third-party partners to ensure talent is lined up against demand.
* Produce regular reports and metrics using casting and talent data; attend weekly standup's.
* Report directly into the Head of Talent & Casting.

**Requirement**

* 5+ years of experience in technical recruitment, resource management, preferably within data, technology, or consultancy sectors. If the person has contractor recruitment this would be preferable.
* Demonstrated understanding of data roles, skills, and technologies (e.g., data science, machine learning, data engineering, analytics).
* Strong knowledge of the UK data talent market and competitive landscape.
* Excellent networking abilities and relationship-building skills.

**Skills**

* Experience with Resourcing Planning Systems – Kantata Preferable.
* Experience of working and managing third party resources to supply demand.
* Experience with Hubspot Preferable.
* Advanced Excel and Office Suite.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Experience working with UK clients/stakeholders.

title: Incubation Manager
description:
The ideal candidate for this position will succeed in this role if they have start up incubation experience.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Identify, screen, and onboard deep-tech startups; assess technology readiness, business potential, and incubation requirements; develop incubation plans and milestones
* Connect faculty researchers, PhD scholars and laboratories with entrepreneurs; facilitate licensing, technology transfer, sponsored research and industry collaboration.
* Build and manage a network of technical experts, entrepreneurs, industry mentors, domain specialists, legal experts and investors.
* Help deep-tech startups understand and navigate sector-specific standards, certifications, regulatory approvals, clinical/field validation, and compliance requirements.

**Qualifications**

* B.Tech with M.Tech in Engineering/Technology or B. Tech with MBA, with a minimum of 5- 7 years of total experience in operations and management.
* Demonstrated experience in the start-up and management ecosystem, including project management, resource management, entrepreneurship development, or technology-driven innovation ecosystems.
* Experience in consultancy roles related to start-up incubation and management.
* Experience in association with the latest technology establishments/technologies and start-up collaborations or co-working ecosystem or skill partner ecosystem in higher education institutions or business incubation organizations is an advantage.
* Preference will be given to candidates with a proven track record in a similar ecosystem.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Lyka Packaging Pvt. Ltd. is a specialized provider of plastic food containers, serving diverse food packaging needs with high\-quality, durable solutions. The company is supported by a professional team of engineers who collaborate closely with customers to design and deliver effective packaging options. Management emphasizes innovation and continuous improvement, ensuring the organization stays aligned with the latest developments in packaging technology and market trends. With an in\-house moulding facility, best\-in\-class injection moulding machines, and integrated printing and in\-mould labelling (IML) capabilities, Lyka Packaging offers end\-to\-end packaging solutions under one roof.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Human Resources Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ernakulam. This role is responsible for overseeing the entire employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee engagement. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include partnering with department heads to identify staffing needs, managing HR policies and compliance, and maintaining accurate HR records and documentation. The Human Resources Manager will handle employee relations, support training and development initiatives, and contribute to a positive, inclusive workplace culture. The role also involves monitoring labor law compliance, supporting payroll and benefits coordination with relevant teams, and recommending process improvements to strengthen HR operations.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong knowledge of core HR functions, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations.
* Experience in HR policy development, implementation, and compliance with applicable labor laws and regulations.
* Skills in conflict resolution, coaching, and supporting employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* Proficiency in HRIS or HR management software and comfortable working with spreadsheets and documentation tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and levels.
* Demonstrated ability to handle confidential information with discretion and maintain professional ethics.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with attention to detail and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; HR certifications are an advantage.
* Prior experience as an HR Manager or in a similar HR leadership role, preferably in manufacturing or packaging industries.
* Comfort working on\-site in Ernakulam and engaging directly with production, engineering, and management teams.
